name: vendors
schema: CREATE TABLE vendors(guid text(32) PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, name text(2048) NOT NULL, id text(2048) NOT NULL, notes text(2048) NOT NULL, currency text(32) NOT NULL, active integer NOT NULL, tax_override integer NOT NULL, addr_name text(1024), addr_addr1 text(1024), addr_addr2 text(1024), addr_addr3 text(1024), addr_addr4 text(1024), addr_phone text(128), addr_fax text(128), addr_email text(256), terms text(32), tax_inc text(2048), tax_table text(32))
